title: Code Autopsy Distributed Contract Delta
description: Schema for the interface-compatibility delta produced by the Phase 4.2 Pillar 3 engines (OpenAPI 3.2.1, Step 37; AsyncAPI 3.1.0, Step 38; Pact, Step 39). The load-bearing property of this document is the verdict algebra: `breaking` is asserted from a positive finding and therefore does not depend on coverage, while `compatible` is a claim that nothing was missed and is therefore only ever asserted over fully-verified coverage. Any consumer that treats `unknown` as a pass has inverted the meaning of this format.

protocol.description: Which contract engine produced this delta.

from_path.description: Repository-relative POSIX path of the baseline contract document.

to_path.description: Repository-relative POSIX path of the candidate contract document.

from_digest.description: BLAKE3 over the canonical baseline contract value. Formatting-insensitive: comments, indentation, and key order do not reach it, so a reformat is not a contract change.

to_digest.description: BLAKE3 over the canonical candidate contract value.

version_change.description: Present only when the two documents declare different specification versions. `null` when unchanged.

changes.description: Detected changes, sorted by kind then subject then detail. Ordering is canonical so that a reordering of the traversal cannot move bytes.

severity.description: `unknown` means the change was detected but no directional evidence exists for it. It prevents a `compatible` verdict without asserting a break.

subject.description: `METHOD /path` for operation-level changes, `METHOD /path location `name`` for parameters, or a JSON pointer for schema-level changes.

detail.description: Human-readable statement of what changed, including the concrete values involved.

coverage.description: How completely the affected surface was modelled.

verdict.description: `breaking` if any change classified breaking was found. Otherwise `unknown` if any change could not be classified or coverage is not `verified`. `compatible` is the only verdict that claims nothing was missed, so it is the only one gated on completeness.

notes.description: Sorted, deduplicated reasons the verdict is not `compatible`.

digest.description: BLAKE3 over the canonical delta body. Excludes `notes` prose, includes `severity`, so a reclassification is a different digest even when the underlying changes are identical.
